# Min

Finds the least number in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Min(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array of numbers. A null element is skipped; any other element that is not a number is a runtime error. Null is read as an empty array, and a value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The least of the numbers, returned as it is in the array; of several equal least numbers, the first. Null when the array holds no numbers: when it is empty, null, or holds only null elements.

## Example

`Min([3, 1, null, 2])` returns `1`.

`Min([])` returns null.
